policy: Each entry is an optional AI activity idea keyed to a source-specific Human Design gate title. It is not doctrine, a capability assessment, an intervention, or evidence of gate/channel activation or biological effect. In explicitly enabled chart-aware mode, a source-versioned calculated map or a clearly identified user-supplied gate list may provide unactivated partner-gate candidates. The AI may offer at most one candidate when it clearly advances the user's stated goal; the person decides whether it fits. Candidate presence does not establish a need, gap, or priority. An unactivated gate is not a deficit. Always describe the practical function first, keep symbolic framing optional, and do not infer needs, traits, hormones, or outcomes from a chart. Each entry also carries controlled interaction-mode labels that describe the activity format (create, organize, compare, communicate, reflect, adapt, practice, coordinate, or learn), never a user trait.

entries.title: Self-Expression
entries.aiAffordance: Offer a blank-canvas creative prompt or help revise a draft without deciding what is authentic to the person.
entries.examplePrompt: Give me a fresh creative prompt, then help me revise my draft while keeping my voice.

entries.title: Higher Knowing
entries.aiAffordance: Map options, constraints, and resources around a direction the person has already named; do not make life decisions for them.
entries.examplePrompt: I have a direction in mind. Help me map my options, constraints, and resources without choosing for me.

entries.title: Ordering
entries.aiAffordance: Turn a messy transition into a few small, reversible experiments and a place to note what changed.
entries.examplePrompt: I'm in the middle of a messy change. Suggest a few small experiments I can try and revise.

entries.title: Formulization
entries.aiAffordance: Generate candidate explanations for a question, label assumptions, and compare them without presenting a guess as certainty.
entries.examplePrompt: Give me several possible explanations for this question, and label assumptions and uncertainties.

entries.title: Fixed Rhythms
entries.aiAffordance: Help design a routine around the person's real schedule, with flexible timing and permission to revise it.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me make a flexible routine that fits my actual schedule and can change when needed.

entries.title: Friction
entries.aiAffordance: Rehearse respectful boundary-setting or a difficult conversation; do not infer reproductive state, compatibility, or emotional authority.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me prepare a respectful boundary for a difficult conversation; don't assume what anyone feels.

entries.title: Role of the Self
entries.aiAffordance: Explore possible roles in a specific project and the responsibilities each would involve, without assigning a fixed role or destiny.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me compare possible roles for this project and what each role would involve.

entries.title: Contribution
entries.aiAffordance: Help shape a contribution for a chosen audience while preserving the person's voice and credit.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me shape this contribution for its audience while preserving my voice and giving proper credit.

entries.title: Focus
entries.aiAffordance: Break a chosen task into a short sequence, identify likely distractions, and let the person choose a stopping point.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me break this task into a few steps and choose a stopping point that works for me.

entries.title: Behavior of the Self
entries.aiAffordance: Help compare an intended action with the person's stated values and context, without labeling their personality or judging their worth.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me compare this possible action with values I've named, without judging me.

entries.title: Ideas
entries.aiAffordance: Offer a few diverse, relevant questions or idea connections, then invite the person to choose one and tell or develop it.
entries.examplePrompt: Give me a few varied questions or connections about this topic so I can choose one to explore.

entries.title: Caution
entries.aiAffordance: Draft a message in several tones and let the person choose whether, when, or whether not to send it.
entries.examplePrompt: Draft a few versions of this message in different tones; I will decide whether to send one.

entries.title: Listener
entries.aiAffordance: Provide a user-controlled listening or journaling prompt and reflect back only what the person chose to share. Avoid inviting unnecessary third-party secrets.
entries.examplePrompt: Ask me a few gentle questions to help me reflect on an experience I choose to share.

entries.title: Power Skills
entries.aiAffordance: Inventory skills and resources the person wants to use toward a chosen goal; avoid claims of innate power or guaranteed success.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me list the skills and resources I want to bring to this goal.

entries.title: Extremes
entries.aiAffordance: Help design a flexible routine with acceptable variation and recovery options rather than forcing uniformity.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me create a routine with room for variation, rest, and changing circumstances.

entries.title: Skills
entries.aiAffordance: Build a small, repeatable practice plan and a self-chosen feedback checklist for a skill.
entries.examplePrompt: Make a short practice plan for this skill and a feedback checklist I can adjust.

entries.title: Opinions
entries.aiAffordance: Compare viewpoints on a topic and distinguish observable evidence from interpretation and preference.
entries.examplePrompt: Compare these viewpoints and separate observable evidence from interpretation and preference.

entries.title: Correction
entries.aiAffordance: Give feedback on a user-selected draft or process using specific observations, an invitation to revise, and strengths as well as issues.
entries.examplePrompt: Review this draft or process with specific, constructive feedback and room for revision.

entries.title: Wanting
entries.aiAffordance: Help identify a stated need and draft a clear request or boundary, without claiming to read unspoken needs.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me identify a need I have named and draft a clear request or boundary.

entries.title: Now
entries.aiAffordance: Turn the person's current priority into one manageable next action; do not frame speed or spontaneity as inherently better.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me turn my current priority into one manageable next action.

entries.title: Hunter/Huntress
entries.aiAffordance: Make a transparent plan for a resource or task the person is responsible for, including shared ownership and limits.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me make a transparent plan for the resources or tasks I'm responsible for, including shared ownership.

entries.title: Openness
entries.aiAffordance: Explore how the person wants to communicate in a particular setting, with options to speak, wait, write, or decline.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me decide how I want to communicate in this setting, including the option to wait or decline.

entries.title: Assimilation
entries.aiAffordance: Translate a complex idea into plain language, an analogy, or a short explanation at the person's chosen level of detail.
entries.examplePrompt: Explain this idea in plain language at the level of detail I choose.

entries.title: Rationalizing
entries.aiAffordance: Use a short “what do I know / what am I replaying / what is the next useful step?” reflection, with a clear option to stop.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me distinguish what I know from what I'm replaying, then find one useful next step or stop point.

entries.title: Spirit of the Self
entries.aiAffordance: Offer a compassion or values reflection in the person's own terms; do not impose spiritual beliefs or moral judgments.
entries.examplePrompt: Offer a compassion or values reflection using my own beliefs and language.

entries.title: Egoist
entries.aiAffordance: Practice a clear, truthful negotiation or request; help identify persuasive language that would become misleading or coercive.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me make this request clear and persuasive without making it misleading or coercive.

entries.title: Caring
entries.aiAffordance: Coordinate a user-selected care task or family checklist while keeping human responsibility and consent clear.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me organize this care task while making responsibilities and consent clear.

entries.title: Game Player
entries.aiAffordance: Explore what feels meaningful in a decision and compare risks, safeguards, and alternatives without glamorizing danger.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me think through what feels meaningful here, the risks involved, and safer alternatives.

entries.title: Saying Yes
entries.aiAffordance: Review a proposed commitment: why it matters, what it costs, what can change, and how the person can say no or renegotiate.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me review this commitment: why it matters, what it costs, and how I could say no or renegotiate.

entries.title: Recognition of Feelings
entries.aiAffordance: Find words for a self-reported feeling and its context; never infer a feeling or hormone level from the chart or chat.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me find words for the feeling I report and note the context, without diagnosing me.

entries.title: Leading
entries.aiAffordance: Prepare a meeting agenda, invitation, or facilitation plan that makes room for others' input and consent.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me prepare a meeting plan that invites input and makes participation optional.

entries.title: Continuity
entries.aiAffordance: Compare ways to make a project sustainable, including when to continue, adapt, pause, or stop.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me decide whether to continue, adapt, pause, or stop this project and what each option costs.

entries.title: Privacy
entries.aiAffordance: Offer a private reflection structure or a user-controlled summary, with clear control over what is saved or shared.
entries.examplePrompt: Give me a private reflection structure and let me choose what, if anything, to save or share.

entries.title: Power
entries.aiAffordance: Offer a menu of ways to approach a self-chosen activity, scaled by the person's stated time, access, and energy constraints.
entries.examplePrompt: Give me several ways to approach this activity that fit my time, access, and energy constraints.

entries.title: Change
entries.aiAffordance: Compare possible next steps during a transition, including what to keep, what to try, and what remains uncertain.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me compare possible next steps in this transition, including what to keep and what remains uncertain.

entries.title: Crisis
entries.aiAffordance: Break a stressful situation into immediate needs and next steps; if someone reports imminent danger, direct them to appropriate human emergency support.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me sort this stressful situation into immediate needs and manageable next steps.

entries.title: Friendship
entries.aiAffordance: Create conversation cards or a household check-in around mutual needs, agreements, and appreciation.
entries.examplePrompt: Make a mutual check-in for our household that helps us discuss needs, agreements, and appreciation.

entries.title: Fighter
entries.aiAffordance: Map a disagreement into the issue, each person's stated concern, and a non-harmful next step; prioritize de-escalation over winning.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me map this disagreement into the issue, each person's stated concern, and a non-harmful next step.

entries.title: Provocateur
entries.aiAffordance: Offer a playful, opt-in perspective shift or creative question, with an easy pass and no deliberate distressing or baiting.
entries.examplePrompt: Offer an optional playful perspective shift about this topic; let me pass without pressure.

entries.title: Aloneness
entries.aiAffordance: Plan chosen solo time and recovery, while optionally making a low-pressure plan to reconnect with a trusted person.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me plan restorative solo time and, if I choose, a low-pressure way to reconnect later.

entries.title: Contraction
entries.aiAffordance: Plan a small, bounded start to an experience, including resource limits and what the person wants to leave open.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me plan a small, bounded start to this experience, including limits and what I want to leave open.

entries.title: Growth
entries.aiAffordance: Break a longer project into milestones, review points, and a deliberate ending or handoff.
entries.examplePrompt: Break this longer project into milestones, review points, and a deliberate ending or handoff.

entries.title: Insight
entries.aiAffordance: Help the person express an unusual idea in their own words, consider alternatives, and identify a small way to examine it.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me put this unusual idea into my own words and consider other explanations or ways to examine it.

entries.title: Alertness
entries.aiAffordance: Help review a user-selected pattern or past experience while labeling uncertainty and avoiding threat profiling or suspicion of others.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me review this pattern while marking uncertainty and avoiding assumptions about other people.

entries.title: Gatherer
entries.aiAffordance: Help organize shared household or team resources, responsibilities, and requests transparently rather than assigning authority.
entries.examplePrompt: Help us organize shared resources and responsibilities transparently without assigning authority.

entries.title: Determination of the Self
entries.aiAffordance: Help the person keep a brief record of how an activity felt in their own body and context, without inferring physiology or telling them what their body means.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me make a brief note about how this activity felt in my body and context, without interpreting it for me.

entries.title: Realizing
entries.aiAffordance: Revisit selected notes or events and offer possible patterns as tentative interpretations for the person to accept or reject.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me look for possible patterns in these notes, and keep each interpretation tentative.

entries.title: Depth
entries.aiAffordance: Build a learning path from introductory to advanced material, paced by the user's interest and available time.
entries.examplePrompt: Build a learning path from introductory to advanced material at a pace I choose.

entries.title: Principles
entries.aiAffordance: Help articulate a boundary, value, or group agreement and consider how it affects everyone involved.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me put a boundary or group value into clear words and consider how it affects everyone involved.

entries.title: Values
entries.aiAffordance: Draft a fair, inclusive set of shared expectations and care responsibilities for a family or team to review together.
entries.examplePrompt: Draft fair shared expectations and care responsibilities for our family or team to review together.

entries.title: Shock
entries.aiAffordance: Prepare for a new or challenging event by reviewing consent, likely surprises, a pause signal, and a safe exit option.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me prepare for this challenging event with a pause signal, consent check, surprises, and a safe exit option.

entries.title: Inaction
entries.aiAffordance: Help create a focus-friendly setting with a chosen timer, break, or distraction boundary; avoid turning rest into failure.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me set up a focus-friendly space with a timer, break, or distraction boundary I choose.

entries.title: Beginnings
entries.aiAffordance: Start a project with a one-step launch plan, a modest first milestone, and a review point.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me launch this project with one small first step and a modest review point.

entries.title: Ambition
entries.aiAffordance: Compare goals with their tradeoffs, resources, relationships, and rest needs; let the person define what success means.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me compare this goal with its tradeoffs, available resources, rest, and relationships.

entries.title: Spirit
entries.aiAffordance: Offer an optional mood or meaning journal that treats entries as the person's account, not a diagnosis or stable trait.
entries.examplePrompt: Give me an optional mood or meaning journal prompt; treat my answer as my own account, not a diagnosis.

entries.title: Stimulation
entries.aiAffordance: Create a short, user-paced story or exploration from a chosen topic, then offer “go deeper,” “tell your version,” and “stop.”
entries.examplePrompt: Create a short, user-paced story about a topic I choose, with options to continue, tell my version, or stop.

entries.title: Intuitive Insight
entries.aiAffordance: Offer a pause to notice immediate impressions, then separate “what I noticed” from “what I think it means” and check relevant evidence.
entries.examplePrompt: Guide me through noticing an immediate impression and separating what I noticed from what I think it means.

entries.title: Aliveness
entries.aiAffordance: Brainstorm enjoyable, accessible activities and ways to make room for them, without prescribing an exercise or health regimen.
entries.examplePrompt: Brainstorm enjoyable, accessible activities that could fit into my life without prescribing a health plan.

entries.title: Sexuality
entries.aiAffordance: Offer consent-centered language for discussing intimacy, boundaries, and privacy; never sexualize a child, pressure a partner, or treat chat as consent.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me find consent-centered words to discuss intimacy, boundaries, and privacy; don't treat this chat as consent.

entries.title: Acceptance
entries.aiAffordance: Identify actual constraints, distinguish fixed from negotiable parts, and generate options within the person's chosen limits.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me separate fixed constraints from negotiable ones and find options within the limits I choose.

entries.title: Mystery
entries.aiAffordance: Explore a big question from several traditions or disciplines; separate known facts, interpretations, and open questions.
entries.examplePrompt: Explore this big question from several disciplines and separate known facts from interpretations and open questions.

entries.title: Detail
entries.aiAffordance: Turn a chosen plan into a checklist, glossary, or clearly labeled set of steps; let the user set the desired detail level.
entries.examplePrompt: Turn this plan into a checklist or glossary at the level of detail I choose.

entries.title: Doubt
entries.aiAffordance: Stress-test a claim by listing evidence, counterexamples, and what would change one's mind, without turning uncertainty into endless checking.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me test this claim with evidence, counterexamples, and what would change my mind, without endless checking.

entries.title: Confusion
entries.aiAffordance: Help sort a pile of notes into themes, identify missing context, and leave unresolved items visibly unresolved.
entries.examplePrompt: Help me sort these notes into themes and uncertainties without forcing an answer before I'm ready.
